questions.questionText: What is the sub-duplicate ratio of 64 : 81?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The sub-duplicate ratio of a : b is the square root of each term: sqrt(64) : sqrt(81) = 8 : 9.

questions.questionText: 6 machines working 8 hours a day produce 480 units. At the same rate, how many units will 9 machines produce in 8 hours?
questions.explanationText: Output varies jointly with the number of machines and the hours worked. The output per machine-hour is 480/(6 x 8) = 10, so 9 machines in 8 hours produce 10 x 9 x 8 = 720 units.

questions.questionText: The present ages of two persons are in the ratio 1 : 3. After 8 years their ages will be in the ratio 3 : 7. What is the present age of the younger person?
questions.explanationText: Let the ages be 1k and 3k. After 8 years, (1k + 8)/(3k + 8) = 3/7. Cross multiplying gives k = 16, so the ages are 16 and 48 years; the younger is 16 years old.

questions.questionText: Find the ratio of 4 litres to 500 ml.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Convert both quantities to the same unit first: 4 litres = 4000 ml. The required ratio is 4000 : 500 = 8 : 1.

questions.questionText: The present ages of two persons are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 6 years their ages will be in the ratio 2 : 3. What is the present age of the younger person?
questions.explanationText: Let the ages be 3k and 5k. After 6 years, (3k + 6)/(5k + 6) = 2/3. Cross multiplying gives k = 6, so the ages are 18 and 30 years; the younger is 18 years old.

questions.questionText: A : B = 2 : 5 and B : C = 7 : 3. If A = 84, what is the value of C?
questions.explanationText: Aligning the common term B gives A : B : C = 14 : 35 : 15. Since A corresponds to 14 parts and A = 84, one part = 6. Hence C = 15 parts = 90.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their difference is 27. What is the smaller number?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the numbers be 2k and 5k. Their difference is 5k - 2k = 3k = 27, so k = 9. The smaller number is 2 x 9 = 18.

questions.questionText: If 4 spare parts cost Rs. 260, what will 18 spare parts cost at the same rate?
questions.explanationText: The cost varies directly with the quantity, so cost/quantity is constant: 260/4 = 65 per unit. Therefore 18 units cost 65 x 18 = Rs. 1170.

questions.questionText: Find the fourth proportional to 7, 14 and 21.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. If a : b = c : x then ax = bc, so x = bc/a = (14 x 21)/7 = 42.

questions.questionText: Three amounts are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. What percentage of the total is made up by the first and third amounts together?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. First and third together make 3 + 5 = 8 parts out of 12, so the percentage is 8/12 x 100 = 66.67%.

questions.questionText: A total of 160 items is split in the ratio 5 : 3. By how much does the larger group exceed the smaller group?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. One part = 160/8 = 20 items. The difference is 2 parts = 40 items.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 7 : 8 and their sum is 135. Find the larger number.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the numbers be 7k and 8k. Then 7k + 8k = 15k = 135, so k = 9, and the larger number is 8 x 9 = 72.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 7 : 3, then A is what percentage of B?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Here A is compared with B, not with the total. A/B = 7/3, so A is 7/3 x 100 = 233.33% of B.

questions.questionText: If (x + 5) : (x - 2) = 9 : 7, what is the value of x?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Cross multiplying, 7(x + 5) = 9(x - 2), so 7x + 35 = 9x - 18. Collecting terms gives 2x = 53 and x = 26.5.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 2 : 7, and A is multiplied by 4 while B is multiplied by 3, what is the new ratio?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The new values are 2 x 4 = 8 parts and 7 x 3 = 21 parts, so the new ratio is 8 : 21 = 8 : 21.

questions.questionText: What is the mean proportional between 5 and 45?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. If x is the mean proportional between a and b then x^2 = ab = 5 x 45 = 225, so x = 15 for positive quantities.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 3 : 4 and B : C = 5 : 6, what is A : B : C?
questions.explanationText: Make the B terms equal. Multiply A : B = 3 : 4 by 5 to get 15 : 20, and B : C = 5 : 6 by 4 to get 20 : 24. Hence A : B : C = 15 : 20 : 24.

questions.questionText: Rs. 960 is to be shared between two branches in the ratio 5 : 11. What is the smaller share?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Sum of the parts = 5 + 11 = 16, so one part = 960/16 = Rs. 60. The smaller share is 5 parts = Rs. 300.

questions.questionText: If the ratio of two quantities is 3 : 5, which statement is correct?

options.text: The first quantity is 60% of the total
The first quantity is 37.5% of the total
The first quantity is 30% of the second
The second quantity is 37.5% of the total

questions.explanationText: The total has 3 + 5 = 8 parts and the first quantity is 3 parts, so it is 3/8 x 100 = 37.5% of the total. Note that 3/5 x 100 = 60% would be the first as a percentage of the second, not of the total.

questions.questionText: A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5. If A = 48, what is the value of C?
questions.explanationText: Aligning the common term B gives A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15. Since A corresponds to 8 parts and A = 48, one part = 6. Hence C = 15 parts = 90.

questions.questionText: Three quantities are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. What fraction of the total is the second quantity?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The total has 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 parts and the second quantity is 3 parts, so its fraction of the total is 3/10 = 3/10.

questions.questionText: Find the ratio of 5 kg to 250 g.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Convert both quantities to the same unit first: 5 kg = 5000 g. The required ratio is 5000 : 250 = 20 : 1.

questions.questionText: The present ages of a father and his son are in the ratio 2 : 5 and the difference between their ages is 18 years. What is the age of the older person?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the ages be 2k and 5k years. The difference is 3k = 18, so k = 6. The older person is 5 x 6 = 30 years old.

questions.questionText: Two quantities are in the ratio 4 : 9. If 25% of the first quantity is removed and the second is unchanged, what is the new ratio?
questions.explanationText: Removing 25% leaves 75% of the first quantity: 4 x 75/100 = 3 parts. The second remains 9 parts, so the new ratio is 3 : 9 = 1 : 3.

questions.questionText: If x : y = 11 : 6, what is the ratio 1/x : 1/y?
questions.explanationText: 1/x : 1/y = (1/11k) : (1/6k) = 6 : 11 after multiplying both terms by 66k, so the reciprocal ratio is the inverse ratio 6 : 11.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 5 : 7, what is (A + B) : (B - A)?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. With A = 5k and B = 7k, A + B = 12k and B - A = 2k, so the required ratio is 12 : 2 = 6 : 1.

questions.questionText: In class A there are 72 students with boys and girls in the ratio 5 : 4, and in class B there are 54 students with boys and girls in the ratio 4 : 5. If the two classes are combined, what is the ratio of boys to girls?
questions.explanationText: Class A has 72 x 5/9 = 40 boys and class B has 54 x 4/9 = 24 boys, giving 64 boys in all. The remaining 62 students are girls, so the combined ratio is 32 : 31.

questions.questionText: z varies directly as x^2 and inversely as y. If x1 : x2 = 4 : 5 and y1 : y2 = 3 : 2, what is z1 : z2?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. z1/z2 = (x1/x2)^2 x (y2/y1) = (4/5)^2 x (2/3) = 32/75, so z1 : z2 = 32 : 75.

questions.questionText: The population of a town is 72000 and the ratio of urban residents to rural residents is 7 : 5. How many rural residents are there?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. One part = 72000/(7 + 5) = 6000. The number of rural residents is 5 parts = 30000.

questions.questionText: A total of 240 items is split in the ratio 7 : 5. By how much does the larger group exceed the smaller group?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. One part = 240/12 = 20 items. The difference is 2 parts = 40 items.

questions.questionText: y varies directly as x. When x = 6, y = 27. What is the value of y when x = 14?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Direct variation means y = kx with k = y/x = 27/6 = 4.5. Hence when x = 14, y = 4.5 x 14 = 63.

questions.questionText: What is the mean proportional between 2 and 50?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. If x is the mean proportional between a and b then x^2 = ab = 2 x 50 = 100, so x = 10 for positive quantities.

questions.questionText: The efficiencies of two workers A and B are in the ratio 4 : 9. If they work separately on the same job, what is the ratio of the times they take?
questions.explanationText: For a fixed amount of work, time is inversely proportional to efficiency. Hence the ratio of times is the inverse of the efficiency ratio, 9 : 4.

questions.questionText: An amount of Rs. 3600 is divided among four departments in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 : 6. How much does the department with the largest share receive?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The ratio has 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 18 parts, so one part = 3600/18 = 200. The largest share is 6 parts = Rs. 1200.

questions.questionText: In a group the ratio of men to women is 3 : 2. What percentage of the group are men?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Men form 3 parts out of a total of 3 + 2 = 5 parts, so the required percentage is 3/5 x 100 = 60%.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their difference is 24. What is the smaller number?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the numbers be 5k and 7k. Their difference is 7k - 5k = 2k = 24, so k = 12. The smaller number is 5 x 12 = 60.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 7 : 10, what is (B - A) : A?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Take A = 7k and B = 10k. Then B - A = 3k, so (B - A) : A = 3 : 7 = 3 : 7.

questions.questionText: If a : b = 3 : 5, find the value of (4a + 3b) : (1a + 1b).
questions.explanationText: Take a = 3k and b = 5k. Then the first expression = 4(3k) + 3(5k) = 27k and the second = 8k, so the required ratio is 27 : 8 = 27 : 8.

questions.questionText: If 32 identical components cost Rs. 1216, how many such components can be bought for Rs. 2280?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The unit rate is 1216/32 = Rs. 38 per component. With Rs. 2280 one can buy 2280/38 = 60 components.

questions.questionText: The present ages of a father and his son are in the ratio 5 : 8 and the difference between their ages is 21 years. What is the age of the older person?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the ages be 5k and 8k years. The difference is 3k = 21, so k = 7. The older person is 8 x 7 = 56 years old.

questions.questionText: Simplify the ratio 3/4 : 5/8.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Divide the two fractions: (3/4) / (5/8) = 6/5. Writing this value as a ratio of whole numbers gives 6 : 5.

questions.questionText: What is the compound ratio of 2 : 3 and 4 : 5?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The compound ratio of a : b and c : d is ac : bd. Here it is (2 x 4) : (3 x 5) = 8 : 15 = 8 : 15.

questions.questionText: If a : b = 2 : 3, find the value of (3a + 2b) : (5a - 1b).
questions.explanationText: Take a = 2k and b = 3k. Then the first expression = 3(2k) + 2(3k) = 12k and the second = 7k, so the required ratio is 12 : 7 = 12 : 7.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 3 : 8, what is (A + B) : (B - A)?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. With A = 3k and B = 8k, A + B = 11k and B - A = 5k, so the required ratio is 11 : 5 = 11 : 5.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 7 : 11 and their difference is 36. What is the smaller number?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the numbers be 7k and 11k. Their difference is 11k - 7k = 4k = 36, so k = 9. The smaller number is 7 x 9 = 63.

questions.questionText: The fourth proportional to 12, 18 and 20 is required for a scale drawing. What is its value?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. For a : b = c : x, cross multiplication gives x = bc/a = (18 x 20)/12 = 30.

questions.questionText: Two positive numbers are in the ratio 2 : 7 and their product is 1134. What is the sum of the two numbers?
questions.explanationText: Let the numbers be 2k and 7k. Their product is 14k^2 = 1134, so k^2 = 81 and k = 9. The numbers are 18 and 63, and their sum is 81.

questions.questionText: Are the ratios 9 : 16 and 12 : 20 equivalent?
questions.explanationText: Reduce each ratio to its simplest form: 9 : 16 = 9 : 16 and 12 : 20 = 3 : 5. Alternatively compare the cross products 9 x 20 = 180 and 16 x 12 = 192. The ratios are therefore not equal.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 6 and their sum is 176. Find the larger number.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the numbers be 5k and 6k. Then 5k + 6k = 11k = 176, so k = 16, and the larger number is 6 x 16 = 96.

questions.questionText: Three partners invest Rs. 3000 for 10 months, Rs. 5000 for 6 months and Rs. 4000 for 9 months. In what ratio should the profit be shared?
questions.explanationText: The profit share is proportional to capital x time: 3000 x 10 = 30000, 5000 x 6 = 30000 and 4000 x 9 = 36000. Simplifying 30000 : 30000 : 36000 gives 5 : 5 : 6.

questions.questionText: The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 7. If 12 is added to the first number, the ratio becomes 3 : 5. What is the second number?
questions.explanationText: Let the numbers be 3k and 7k. Then (3k + 12)/(7k) = 3/5. Cross multiplying, 5(3k + 12) = 3 x 7k, which gives k = 10. Hence the numbers are 30 and 70, and the second is 70.

questions.questionText: In a survey 45% of the respondents preferred brand X and the rest preferred brand Y. What is the ratio of brand X supporters to brand Y supporters?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. If 45% prefer X then 55% prefer Y, so the required ratio is 45 : 55 = 9 : 11.

questions.questionText: Which of the following ratios is greater: 9 : 13 or 7 : 10?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Compare by cross multiplication: 9 x 10 = 90 and 7 x 13 = 91. Since 90 < 91, the ratio 7 : 10 is greater.

questions.questionText: An amount of Rs. 2800 is divided among four departments in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4 : 5. How much does the department with the largest share receive?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The ratio has 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 14 parts, so one part = 2800/14 = 200. The largest share is 5 parts = Rs. 1000.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 3 : 2, then A is what percentage of B?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Here A is compared with B, not with the total. A/B = 3/2, so A is 3/2 x 100 = 150% of B.

questions.questionText: The present ages of a father and his son are in the ratio 3 : 5 and the difference between their ages is 12 years. What is the age of the older person?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Let the ages be 3k and 5k years. The difference is 2k = 12, so k = 6. The older person is 5 x 6 = 30 years old.

questions.questionText: Divide 840 rupees between two persons in the ratio 4 : 3. What is the larger share?
questions.explanationText: Total number of parts = 4 + 3 = 7, so one part = 840/7 = 120. The larger share corresponds to 4 parts, i.e. 4 x 120 = 480.

questions.questionText: 195 work hours are to be allocated to two tasks in the ratio 2 : 3. How many work hours does the first one receive?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. One part = 195/(2 + 3) = 39, so the first allocation is 2 parts = 78 work hours.

questions.questionText: 5 machines working 6 hours a day produce 300 units. At the same rate, how many units will 8 machines produce in 6 hours?
questions.explanationText: Output varies jointly with the number of machines and the hours worked. The output per machine-hour is 300/(5 x 6) = 10, so 8 machines in 6 hours produce 10 x 8 x 6 = 480 units.

questions.questionText: y varies as the square root of x. If x1 : x2 = 4 : 9, what is y1 : y2?
questions.explanationText: Since y is proportional to the square root of x, the ratio y1 : y2 equals the square root of each term of x1 : x2 = 4 : 9, which gives 2 : 3.

questions.questionText: If 12 printed manuals cost Rs. 900, what will 20 printed manuals cost at the same rate?
questions.explanationText: The cost varies directly with the quantity, so cost/quantity is constant: 900/12 = 75 per unit. Therefore 20 units cost 75 x 20 = Rs. 1500.

questions.questionText: Three amounts are in the ratio 1 : 3 : 4. What percentage of the total is made up by the first and third amounts together?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. First and third together make 1 + 4 = 5 parts out of 8, so the percentage is 5/8 x 100 = 62.50%.

questions.questionText: An amount of Rs. 2100 is divided among Anil, Bhaskar and Chetan in the ratio 5 : 6 : 10. How much does Bhaskar receive?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The ratio has 5 + 6 + 10 = 21 parts, so one part = 2100/21 = 100. Bhaskar receives 6 parts = Rs. 600.

questions.questionText: Two quantities are in the ratio 3 : 8. If 50% of the first quantity is removed and the second is unchanged, what is the new ratio?
questions.explanationText: Removing 50% leaves 50% of the first quantity: 3 x 50/100 = 1.5 parts. The second remains 8 parts, so the new ratio is 1.5 : 8 = 3 : 16.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 4 : 1, then A is what percentage of B?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Here A is compared with B, not with the total. A/B = 4/1, so A is 4/1 x 100 = 400% of B.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 1 : 2, B : C = 3 : 4 and C : D = 5 : 6, find A : D.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. A/D = (A/B) x (B/C) x (C/D) = (1/2) x (3/4) x (5/6) = 15/48, so A : D = 5 : 16.

questions.questionText: y varies directly as x. When x = 4, y = 18. What is the value of y when x = 10?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Direct variation means y = kx with k = y/x = 18/4 = 4.5. Hence when x = 10, y = 4.5 x 10 = 45.

questions.questionText: If 2 : 9 = x : 54, what is the value of x?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Cross multiplying 2/9 = x/54 gives 9 x = 2 x 54 = 108, so x = 12.

questions.questionText: The present ages of two persons are in the ratio 4 : 5. After 8 years their ages will be in the ratio 6 : 7. What is the present age of the younger person?
questions.explanationText: Let the ages be 4k and 5k. After 8 years, (4k + 8)/(5k + 8) = 6/7. Cross multiplying gives k = 4, so the ages are 16 and 20 years; the younger is 16 years old.

questions.questionText: z varies directly as the square root of x and inversely as y. When x = 9 and y = 5, z = 30. Find z when x = 16 and y = 3.
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. z = k sqrt(x) / y, so k = z y / sqrt(x) = 30 x 5 / 3 = 50. Then z = 50 x 4 / 3 = 66.67.

questions.questionText: Which of the following ratios is greater: 3 : 5 or 4 : 7?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Compare by cross multiplication: 3 x 7 = 21 and 4 x 5 = 20. Since 21 > 20, the ratio 3 : 5 is greater.

questions.questionText: 240 laptops are to be allocated to two teams in the ratio 5 : 7. How many laptops does the first one receive?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. One part = 240/(5 + 7) = 20, so the first allocation is 5 parts = 100 laptops.

questions.questionText: y varies directly as x. When x = 5, y = 40. What is the value of y when x = 9?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. Direct variation means y = kx with k = y/x = 40/5 = 8. Hence when x = 9, y = 8 x 9 = 72.

questions.questionText: If x : y = 4 : 9, what is the ratio 1/x : 1/y?
questions.explanationText: 1/x : 1/y = (1/4k) : (1/9k) = 9 : 4 after multiplying both terms by 36k, so the reciprocal ratio is the inverse ratio 9 : 4.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 5 : 6, and A is multiplied by 3 while B is multiplied by 2, what is the new ratio?
questions.explanationText: Set up the ratio as a pair of parts of a common unit, keep the quantities in the same unit, and use the proportion or variation relation that the situation requires. The new values are 5 x 3 = 15 parts and 6 x 2 = 12 parts, so the new ratio is 15 : 12 = 5 : 4.

questions.questionText: If A : B = 4 : 7 and B : C = 2 : 3, what is A : B : C?
questions.explanationText: Make the B terms equal. Multiply A : B = 4 : 7 by 2 to get 8 : 14, and B : C = 2 : 3 by 7 to get 14 : 21. Hence A : B : C = 8 : 14 : 21.

questions.questionText: The ratio of two numbers is 4 : 5. If 9 is added to the first number, the ratio becomes 7 : 8. What is the second number?
questions.explanationText: Let the numbers be 4k and 5k. Then (4k + 9)/(5k) = 7/8. Cross multiplying, 8(4k + 9) = 7 x 5k, which gives k = 24. Hence the numbers are 96 and 120, and the second is 120.
